sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.95 Stable

  • Real upload progress: Media Studio upload and replace toasts now follow browser upload progress instead of sitting idle and jumping to 100% after the request finishes.
  • Collection uploads: Uploading while an MV collection is open now automatically adds the new media to that collection without removing any other memberships.
  • Replace preview refresh: Replace File now refreshes the selected attachment preview immediately after completion, so the new file is visible without closing and reopening Media Studio.
  • Load-state hardening: Media Studio clears its loading state correctly after successful refreshes, including post-upload and post-replace reloads.
  • Regression guard: The release guard now protects real upload progress, open-collection upload assignment, and immediate replacement preview refresh.

v1.3.93 Stable

  • Upload progress: Media Studio now shows a non-blocking MV progress toast as soon as one or more files begin uploading, before the Uploaded confirmation appears.
  • Replace workflow: Replace File now uses a toast-style “Replacing file” progress state instead of blanking the gallery, while keeping the selected attachment, details, collections, and known consumers intact.
  • Delete copy: Deleting one media file now reports singular success wording; deleting multiple files keeps batch wording.
  • Collection polish: MV collection ownership pills are quieter so collection names stay visually dominant.
  • Regression guard: Upload progress, replacement progress, single-vs-batch delete feedback, checkbox anchoring, scoped scrollbars, collection persistence, and internal drag/drop are protected by the Media Studio guard.

v1.3.92 Stable

  • Media usage accuracy: Usage & replace impact now ignores WordPress attachment bookkeeping fields such as _wp_attached_file and _wp_attachment_metadata, so unused files no longer look used by themselves.
  • Upload feedback: Media Studio now shows upload progress immediately while files are being uploaded.
  • Replace workflow: Replace File now uses a branded replacement busy state and keeps the selected attachment, refreshed details, consumers, and collection memberships intact.
  • Delete copy: One selected media item uses singular delete confirmation copy; multiple selected files use batch wording.
  • Collection polish: MV collection ownership pills are quieter so collection names remain dominant.
  • Regression guard: Media Studio checkbox anchoring, scoped scrollbars, collection persistence, internal drag/drop, icon picker styling, usage impact, upload feedback, and delete copy are now covered by the release guard.

v1.3.62 Stable

  • Folder Hierarchy Display: Nested visual tree display showing only leaf names in the sidebar.
  • Folder-Plugin-to-MV Migration UI: Added a folder-plugin migration section under Media Studio settings in Modules settings. Added options to migrate all detected folders to local collections, toggle hiding of external folders in the sidebar, and confirm action.
  • State Synchronization: Real-time event communication between the settings panel and Media Studio for seamless layout updates without page reload.

v1.3.61 Stable

  • Removed codebase languages distribution: Removed language bars based on user feedback.
